result.instructions: Tools for Enboarder, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which onboarding workflows are active in Enboarder?"; "Show the new hires launched this month and their status."; "List the answers submitted to our IT equipment form.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Enboarder data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run enboarder_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run enboarder_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run enboarder_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. enboarder_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: enboarder_list_workflows
tools.title: List workflows
tools.description: List workflow definitions (id, name, isActive). Start here to find workflow ids. GET /reports/workflows.

tools.name: enboarder_get_workflow_properties
tools.title: Get workflow properties
tools.description: List the categories, custom fields and stakeholders (managers) configured for one workflow. GET /reports/workflows/{id}/properties.

tools.name: enboarder_get_workflow_data
tools.title: Get workflow data
tools.description: List launched workflow instances (employee, status, start date, custom fields, managers) across all workflows. By default the last year. Returns up to one page; pass next_key for more. GET /reports/workflows/data.

next_key.description: nextKey from the previous response, to get the next page.

tools.name: enboarder_get_workflow_data_by_id
tools.title: Get data for one workflow
tools.description: List launched instances of ONE workflow (employee, status, start date, custom fields, managers). By default the last year. GET /reports/workflows/{id}/data.

next_key.description: nextKey from the previous response, to get the next page.

tools.name: enboarder_get_form_properties
tools.title: Get form properties
tools.description: List the questions (field names, types, options) of one form. GET /reports/forms/{id}/properties.

tools.name: enboarder_get_form_data
tools.title: Get form submissions
tools.description: Get form submissions with questions, answers and the workflow custom fields. 500 records per page; pass next_key for more. GET /reports/forms/{id}/data.

submit_start_date.description: Start of the submit date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

submit_end_date.description: End of the submit date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

select.description: Comma separated field names to return (default: all).

next_key.description: nextKey from the previous response, to get the next page.

tools.name: enboarder_get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: Get one employee profile by its external id (contact details, profile fields, optionally active workflows). GET /restapi/v1/profile/{id}.

include_active_workflows.description: Also return up to 10 active workflows.

tools.name: enboarder_list_brands
tools.title: List brands
tools.description: List brands of the account. GET /restapi/v1/settings/brand/all.

tools.name: enboarder_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List locations of the account. GET /restapi/v1/settings/location/all.

tools.name: enboarder_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List categories of the account. GET /restapi/v1/settings/category/all.

tools.name: enboarder_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List custom fields of the account. GET /restapi/v1/settings/customfield/all.

tools.name: enboarder_launch_workflow
tools.title: Launch a workflow (basic)
tools.description: WRITE: start an onboarding workflow for one employee with one manager (this can send messages to the employee and manager). Needs the employee full name, one contact (email or mobile), the manager full name and contact, and the start date. mode 0 (default) does not launch if the external id already exists. POST /restapi/v1/startwf/basic.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields as name/value pairs. Names must match the labels in Enboarder.

name.description: Label of the custom field, or 'brand', 'location', or a category name.

external_id.description: Unique id from your system. Enboarder makes one if omitted.

mode.description: 0 = skip if external id exists (default); 1 = cancel the existing one and relaunch; 2 = allow several with different criteria.

tools.name: enboarder_update_workflow
tools.title: Update a running workflow
tools.description: WRITE: change a running workflow found by its external id (partial update: send only what changes, for example start_date or custom fields). Fails if the workflow is complete or cancelled. PUT /restapi/v1/updatewf.

external_id.description: External id of the workflow instance.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields as name/value pairs. Names must match the labels in Enboarder.

name.description: Label of the custom field, or 'brand', 'location', or a category name.

tools.name: enboarder_cancel_workflow
tools.title: Cancel a workflow
tools.description: WRITE (cannot be undone): cancel a running workflow found by its external id. mode ALL (default) cancels every workflow with that external id. POST /restapi/v1/cancelwf.

external_id.description: External id of the workflow instance.
